claims: The official application for 2027 Masters tickets opens on June 1, 2026.
The official application for 2027 Masters tickets closes on June 20, 2026.
The official application for 2027 Masters tickets is via tickets.masters.com.
Applicants can enter a lottery for practice rounds costing $125–$150.
Applicants can enter a lottery for daily tournament tickets costing $160.
Winners are notified in late July.
Estimated cost based on 2026 is ≈$150 for tournament days.
Estimated cost based on 2026 is ≈$125-$150 for practice rounds.
Only one application per person is allowed for 2027 Masters tickets.
Applicants can apply for multiple days.
Winners are selected via a random drawing in July.
Augusta National Women's Amateur is on April 3, 2027.
